name: finflow-backend-manager
description: NPM scripts to manage Java microservices

scripts.start-infra: npx concurrently "npm run eureka" "npm run config"
scripts.start-services: npx concurrently "npm run auth" "npm run application" "npm run document" "npm run admin" "npm run notification"
scripts.start-all: npx concurrently "npm run eureka" "npm run config" "npm run auth" "npm run application" "npm run document" "npm run admin" "npm run notification" "npm run gateway"
